```{python}
#| include: false
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("data/readmissions.csv")
all_wards = df[df["ward"] == "All wards"].copy()
all_wards["after"] = all_wards["quarter"] >= "2025 Q1"
before = all_wards.loc[~all_wards["after"], "rate"].mean()
after = all_wards.loc[all_wards["after"], "rate"].mean()
```

## The question

Did the new discharge protocol reduce 30-day readmissions?

## What we found

Readmissions fell from `{python} f"{before:.1f}"`% to `{python} f"{after:.1f}"`%.
